fields.title: Facebook ads benchmark record
fields.description: Dataset envelope (_input / _source / _scrapedAt / recordType) on top of benchmark rows. One OVERVIEW row per niche, many BENCHMARK rows per niche (one per ranked entry), COMPARISON rows when more than one niche was run, optional AD_SAMPLE rows, one RUN_SUMMARY, and ERROR rows when a search fails. Facebook changes its payload without notice, so unlisted fields pass through rather than failing the run.

_input.title: Input
_input.description: The niche this record belongs to.

_scrapedAt.title: Computed at
_scrapedAt.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp when this record was emitted.

recordType.title: Record type
recordType.description: BENCHMARK, COMPARISON, AD_SAMPLE, RUN_SUMMARY or ERROR.

_error.title: Error
_error.description: Failure rows only: fetch_failed or unexpected_error.

niche.title: Niche
niche.description: The niche label this row was computed for. COMPARISON rows use ALL_NICHES.

metric.title: Metric
metric.description: OVERVIEW, TOP_CTA, TOP_FORMAT, TOP_ADVERTISER, TOP_PLATFORM, TOP_HEADLINE, TOP_LANDING_DOMAIN, TOP_WORD, TOP_PHRASE_2, TOP_PHRASE_3, LONGEVITY_BY_CTA, LONGEVITY_BY_FORMAT, LONGEVITY_BY_COPY_LENGTH, or COMPARE_*.

rank.title: Rank
rank.description: Position within this metric's ranking, 1 = most common (or longest-running, for LONGEVITY_* metrics).

value.title: Value
value.description: The ranked thing itself: a CTA label, a format, an advertiser, a word or phrase, a domain, or a copy-length band.

count.title: Ads
count.description: How many ads in the sample carry this value. Words and phrases are counted once per ad, so a slogan repeated six times in one ad counts once.

share.title: Share of sample (%)
share.description: count as a percentage of sampleSize.

sampleSize.title: Sample size
sampleSize.description: How many ads this row was computed from. Always read a benchmark together with this number.

medianRunningDays.title: Median days on air
medianRunningDays.description: The midpoint of how long these ads have been running. This is the closest thing to a performance signal public data allows: advertisers keep paying for creatives that work.

p90RunningDays.title: 90th percentile days on air
p90RunningDays.description: How long the most durable tenth of these ads have run.

activeShare.title: Active share (%)
activeShare.description: OVERVIEW rows: percentage of the sample still running.

videoShare.title: Video share (%)
videoShare.description: OVERVIEW rows: percentage of the sample carrying a video creative.

distinctAdvertisers.title: Advertisers
distinctAdvertisers.description: OVERVIEW rows: how many different pages are represented in the sample.

adsPerAdvertiser.title: Ads per advertiser
adsPerAdvertiser.description: OVERVIEW rows: sample size divided by distinct advertisers. A high number means a few pages dominate the niche.

medianCopyWords.title: Median copy length (words)
medianCopyWords.description: OVERVIEW rows: the typical ad body length in this niche.

sharePerNiche.title: Share per niche (%)
sharePerNiche.description: COMPARISON rows: the same value's share within each niche, side by side.

overview.title: Niche overview
overview.description: One row per niche: sample size, how active it is, creative mix and copy length.

rankings.title: Rankings
rankings.description: Every top-N ranking: CTAs, formats, advertisers, words, phrases, headlines and domains.

longevity.title: What survives longest
longevity.description: Median days on air grouped by CTA, format and copy length.
